en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a grand Neo-Renaissance style building with arched windows and ornate roofline, seen from a cobblestone street with horse-drawn carriages and small trees lining the sidewalk. Hungarian text beneath the image identifies the scene as a greeting from Pécs and names the building as the palace of the Catholic Circle. The back side has the printed Hungarian phrase for postcard, "LEVELEZŐ-LAP.", address lines, and an affixed green 40-filler Hungarian Kingdom postage stamp depicting agricultural workers.
